reason: An offline, presentation-only visual skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with light and dark modes and responsive accessibility-oriented styling.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供离线运行的 Fate 灵感主题皮肤，支持浅色、深色、系统模式及响应式界面样式。
summaries.en: An offline Fate-inspired visual skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with light, dark, system, and responsive presentation modes.

capabilities: Applies a visual theme to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
Supports light, dark, system, reduced-motion, forced-colors, and narrow-screen presentation modes
Runs offline without reading user data or making network requests
